Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a professional teacher certification tuition reimbursement program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to professional teacher certification tuitionreimbursement; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.300 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The educator tuition reimbursement program is created. Thepurpose of the program is to provide full tuition reimbursement topublic school teachers who take college courses as a requirement forobtaining their professional certification, as required under RCW28A.410.250. The program shall be administered by the office of thesuperintendent of public instruction. (2) With funds specifically appropriated for this purpose, theoffice of the superintendent of public instruction shall provide fullor partial tuition reimbursement to any teacher employed in the commonschool system of the state, subject to the following requirements: (a) For coursework completed at an institution of higher educationas defined in RCW 28B.10.016, reimbursement shall be based on actualtuition and fees paid by the teacher for the coursework; p. 1 SB 5956 (b) For coursework completed at an institution of higher educationas defined in RCW 28B.07.020(4), reimbursement shall be based on, andshall not exceed, an average of the tuition and fees charged forcomparable coursework at the regional universities designated in RCW28B.35.010; and (c) The coursework must apply toward professional certificationrequirements adopted by the state board of education.
